description: Kernel tuning of the orbit updater on the tuning worlds (development worlds 0 to 5 of each regime and mass model), protocol budget (8192 particles, 32 rungs, 4 moves).

key_pairs.note: updater_a and updater_b keys per world; key_ess is the multinomial size implied by their bin disagreement (amendment A3); tv_keys is their ln P total variation; rungs_init is the initializer's rung count.

lanes_R2_ti_window.note: 8 keys per tuning world in R2; lane_ess is the multinomial size implied by the across-lane variance of the ln P bins; ref_* compare with the mean of reference_1 and reference_2 at the protocol budget (Kish ESS listed).

references_R2_ti_window.note: Lambert depth fits at 2^20 proposals, tuning worlds of R2.

ti_reference_budget.note: Kish ESS of the TI reference on the tuning worlds (development worlds 0 to 5, ti_window), per world the smaller of reference_1 and reference_2. Floor: 200 in the worst world (the repeat-noise certification bound of 0.25 delta2 over 152 worlds tolerates one world near ESS 100 when the rest are in the thousands). The Lambert depth fit meets it in R2 at two epochs only; its ESS grows about linearly with the budget, so no budget up to 2^23 meets it in R2 at three epochs or in R3. The collapsed prior importance sampler (one run of 2^20 draws per world, a spike, not the protocol method) meets it everywhere.
